mechanism: Foscarnet causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair renal function and potentiate irbesartan's effects on renal hemodynamics and potassium retention.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, electrolytes, and potassium closely; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy; consider irbesartan dose adjustment or temporary discontinuation if renal function deteriorates significantly.
